verdict.rationale: GitBook supports versioning of docs via Git sync/version control and review via Change Requests (including AI-agent-authored changes reviewed by 'GitBook Agent'), which maps loosely to versioning/reviewing AI-driven changes, but there is no explicit documentation of an 'automations' concept (e.g., agent workflows) being versioned or rolled back as a distinct object — only content/page-level version control and change-request review are evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit rollback mechanism for automations, evidence of automation objects (not just docs content) under version control, independent confirmation of the review/rollback workflow.
